correctness.rationale: The averaged within-part triangle bound and level-set (layer-cake) inequality give the global upper bound. Explicit quotient pseudometrics attain every subset ratio, and a rigorous swap-or-delete exchange argument forces at least one maximizer to be a part-size prefix. Exact boundary cases k=2 and singleton classes are included. The standalone checker passed 7,136 supplementary assertions.

value.rationale: The optimal exponent-one nonlinear metric Poincare constant is a natural expansion invariant. The theorem classifies all irregular complete multipartite graphs, replaces exponentially many subset choices by k prefixes, and demonstrates nontrivial intermediate optimizer phases. It is neither a renaming of the standard graph Laplacian gap nor a calculation only for isolated sizes.
